text: 重磅利好！中共中央、国务院，权威定调！吴清最新发声！财政部、发改委重要部署！影响一周市场的十大消息
text_en: Major positive news! The CPC Central Committee and the State Council provide authoritative direction! Wu Qing makes the latest statement! Important deployments from the Ministry of Finance and the NDRC! Ten major messages affecting the market this week
